title: PrismStudio 1.3.0 — the face you already know
notes: It now looks like the editor you have open all day: Dark+ to the hex, blue status bar and all, as the default skin.
Breadcrumbs above the editor, a minimap down the right, and indent guides through the code.
The menu bar is back in the title bar, and the side bar names the region on top with the folder underneath.
Skins can now name their own surfaces and token colours, so a palette copied from somewhere else stays exactly what it was copied from. Every existing skin still works.
